definitions.description: List Servers
definitions.documentation:
List Servers. GET /servers. One bounded HTTPS request to api.hetzner.cloud only. Encrypted tokenSecret must be explicit; context.secrets.get is await-compatible. Read only. Lists fetch one requested page (maximum 50) and return nextPage for manual continuation. Provider-added fields are omitted from the typed result. Response/request limits 1 MiB/128 KiB, deadline 100..30000ms, independently bounded cleanup 250ms. Sensitive generated passwords are deliberately excluded. Sources: https://docs.hetzner.cloud/reference/cloud https://docs.hetzner.cloud/changelog https://docs.hetzner.com/cloud/api/getting-started/using-api/ https://github.com/hetznercloud/hcloud-go/tree/main/hcloud/schema

definitions.name: Get Server (Direct)
definitions.description: Get Server
definitions.documentation:
Get Server. GET /servers/{id}. One bounded HTTPS request to api.hetzner.cloud only. Encrypted tokenSecret must be explicit; context.secrets.get is await-compatible. Read only. Lists fetch one requested page (maximum 50) and return nextPage for manual continuation. Provider-added fields are omitted from the typed result. Response/request limits 1 MiB/128 KiB, deadline 100..30000ms, independently bounded cleanup 250ms. Sensitive generated passwords are deliberately excluded. Sources: https://docs.hetzner.cloud/reference/cloud https://docs.hetzner.cloud/changelog https://docs.hetzner.com/cloud/api/getting-started/using-api/ https://github.com/hetznercloud/hcloud-go/tree/main/hcloud/schema

definitions.description: Delete Server
definitions.documentation:
Delete Server. DELETE /servers/{id}. One bounded HTTPS request to api.hetzner.cloud only. Encrypted tokenSecret must be explicit; context.secrets.get is await-compatible. Requires confirmWrites=true, $retries=0 and request.confirmation exactly servers-delete. Acceptance does not establish completion; poll an Action Status node, and never automatically replay uncertain writes. Provider-added fields are omitted from the typed result. Response/request limits 1 MiB/128 KiB, deadline 100..30000ms, independently bounded cleanup 250ms. Sensitive generated passwords are deliberately excluded. Sources: https://docs.hetzner.cloud/reference/cloud https://docs.hetzner.cloud/changelog https://docs.hetzner.com/cloud/api/getting-started/using-api/ https://github.com/hetznercloud/hcloud-go/tree/main/hcloud/schema

definitions.documentation:
Update Server. PUT /servers/{id}. One bounded HTTPS request to api.hetzner.cloud only. Encrypted tokenSecret must be explicit; context.secrets.get is await-compatible. Requires confirmWrites=true, $retries=0 and request.confirmation exactly servers-update. Acceptance does not establish completion; poll an Action Status node, and never automatically replay uncertain writes. Provider-added fields are omitted from the typed result. Response/request limits 1 MiB/128 KiB, deadline 100..30000ms, independently bounded cleanup 250ms. Sensitive generated passwords are deliberately excluded. Sources: https://docs.hetzner.cloud/reference/cloud https://docs.hetzner.cloud/changelog https://docs.hetzner.com/cloud/api/getting-started/using-api/ https://github.com/hetznercloud/hcloud-go/tree/main/hcloud/schema

definitions.name: List Images (Direct)
definitions.description: List Images
definitions.documentation:
List Images. GET /images. One bounded HTTPS request to api.hetzner.cloud only. Encrypted tokenSecret must be explicit; context.secrets.get is await-compatible. Read only. Lists fetch one requested page (maximum 50) and return nextPage for manual continuation. Provider-added fields are omitted from the typed result. Response/request limits 1 MiB/128 KiB, deadline 100..30000ms, independently bounded cleanup 250ms. Sensitive generated passwords are deliberately excluded. Sources: https://docs.hetzner.cloud/reference/cloud https://docs.hetzner.cloud/changelog https://docs.hetzner.com/cloud/api/getting-started/using-api/ https://github.com/hetznercloud/hcloud-go/tree/main/hcloud/schema

definitions.name: Update Image (Direct)
definitions.description: Update Image
definitions.documentation:
Update Image. PUT /images/{id}. One bounded HTTPS request to api.hetzner.cloud only. Encrypted tokenSecret must be explicit; context.secrets.get is await-compatible. Requires confirmWrites=true, $retries=0 and request.confirmation exactly images-update. Acceptance does not establish completion; poll an Action Status node, and never automatically replay uncertain writes. Provider-added fields are omitted from the typed result. Response/request limits 1 MiB/128 KiB, deadline 100..30000ms, independently bounded cleanup 250ms. Sensitive generated passwords are deliberately excluded. Sources: https://docs.hetzner.cloud/reference/cloud https://docs.hetzner.cloud/changelog https://docs.hetzner.com/cloud/api/getting-started/using-api/ https://github.com/hetznercloud/hcloud-go/tree/main/hcloud/schema

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: List Server Types (Direct)
definitions.description: List Server Types
definitions.documentation:
List Server Types. GET /server_types. One bounded HTTPS request to api.hetzner.cloud only. Encrypted tokenSecret must be explicit; context.secrets.get is await-compatible. Read only. Lists fetch one requested page (maximum 50) and return nextPage for manual continuation. Provider-added fields are omitted from the typed result. Response/request limits 1 MiB/128 KiB, deadline 100..30000ms, independently bounded cleanup 250ms. Sensitive generated passwords are deliberately excluded. Sources: https://docs.hetzner.cloud/reference/cloud https://docs.hetzner.cloud/changelog https://docs.hetzner.com/cloud/api/getting-started/using-api/ https://github.com/hetznercloud/hcloud-go/tree/main/hcloud/schema

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: Get Location (Direct)
definitions.description: Get Location
definitions.documentation:
Get Location. GET /locations/{id}. One bounded HTTPS request to api.hetzner.cloud only. Encrypted tokenSecret must be explicit; context.secrets.get is await-compatible. Read only. Lists fetch one requested page (maximum 50) and return nextPage for manual continuation. Provider-added fields are omitted from the typed result. Response/request limits 1 MiB/128 KiB, deadline 100..30000ms, independently bounded cleanup 250ms. Sensitive generated passwords are deliberately excluded. Sources: https://docs.hetzner.cloud/reference/cloud https://docs.hetzner.cloud/changelog https://docs.hetzner.com/cloud/api/getting-started/using-api/ https://github.com/hetznercloud/hcloud-go/tree/main/hcloud/schema

definitions.name: List Volumes (Direct)
definitions.description: List Volumes
definitions.documentation:
List Volumes. GET /volumes. One bounded HTTPS request to api.hetzner.cloud only. Encrypted tokenSecret must be explicit; context.secrets.get is await-compatible. Read only. Lists fetch one requested page (maximum 50) and return nextPage for manual continuation. Provider-added fields are omitted from the typed result. Response/request limits 1 MiB/128 KiB, deadline 100..30000ms, independently bounded cleanup 250ms. Sensitive generated passwords are deliberately excluded. Sources: https://docs.hetzner.cloud/reference/cloud https://docs.hetzner.cloud/changelog https://docs.hetzner.com/cloud/api/getting-started/using-api/ https://github.com/hetznercloud/hcloud-go/tree/main/hcloud/schema

definitions.description: Update Volume
definitions.documentation:
Update Volume. PUT /volumes/{id}. One bounded HTTPS request to api.hetzner.cloud only. Encrypted tokenSecret must be explicit; context.secrets.get is await-compatible. Requires confirmWrites=true, $retries=0 and request.confirmation exactly volumes-update. Acceptance does not establish completion; poll an Action Status node, and never automatically replay uncertain writes. Provider-added fields are omitted from the typed result. Response/request limits 1 MiB/128 KiB, deadline 100..30000ms, independently bounded cleanup 250ms. Sensitive generated passwords are deliberately excluded. Sources: https://docs.hetzner.cloud/reference/cloud https://docs.hetzner.cloud/changelog https://docs.hetzner.com/cloud/api/getting-started/using-api/ https://github.com/hetznercloud/hcloud-go/tree/main/hcloud/schema

definitions.description: List Networks
definitions.documentation:
List Networks. GET /networks. One bounded HTTPS request to api.hetzner.cloud only. Encrypted tokenSecret must be explicit; context.secrets.get is await-compatible. Read only. Lists fetch one requested page (maximum 50) and return nextPage for manual continuation. Provider-added fields are omitted from the typed result. Response/request limits 1 MiB/128 KiB, deadline 100..30000ms, independently bounded cleanup 250ms. Sensitive generated passwords are deliberately excluded. Sources: https://docs.hetzner.cloud/reference/cloud https://docs.hetzner.cloud/changelog https://docs.hetzner.com/cloud/api/getting-started/using-api/ https://github.com/hetznercloud/hcloud-go/tree/main/hcloud/schema

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: Update Network (Direct)
definitions.description: Update Network
definitions.documentation:
Update Network. PUT /networks/{id}. One bounded HTTPS request to api.hetzner.cloud only. Encrypted tokenSecret must be explicit; context.secrets.get is await-compatible. Requires confirmWrites=true, $retries=0 and request.confirmation exactly networks-update. Acceptance does not establish completion; poll an Action Status node, and never automatically replay uncertain writes. Provider-added fields are omitted from the typed result. Response/request limits 1 MiB/128 KiB, deadline 100..30000ms, independently bounded cleanup 250ms. Sensitive generated passwords are deliberately excluded. Sources: https://docs.hetzner.cloud/reference/cloud https://docs.hetzner.cloud/changelog https://docs.hetzner.com/cloud/api/getting-started/using-api/ https://github.com/hetznercloud/hcloud-go/tree/main/hcloud/schema

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.description: List Firewalls
definitions.documentation:
List Firewalls. GET /firewalls. One bounded HTTPS request to api.hetzner.cloud only. Encrypted tokenSecret must be explicit; context.secrets.get is await-compatible. Read only. Lists fetch one requested page (maximum 50) and return nextPage for manual continuation. Provider-added fields are omitted from the typed result. Response/request limits 1 MiB/128 KiB, deadline 100..30000ms, independently bounded cleanup 250ms. Sensitive generated passwords are deliberately excluded. Sources: https://docs.hetzner.cloud/reference/cloud https://docs.hetzner.cloud/changelog https://docs.hetzner.com/cloud/api/getting-started/using-api/ https://github.com/hetznercloud/hcloud-go/tree/main/hcloud/schema

definitions.name: Update Firewall (Direct)
definitions.description: Update Firewall
definitions.documentation:
Update Firewall. PUT /firewalls/{id}. One bounded HTTPS request to api.hetzner.cloud only. Encrypted tokenSecret must be explicit; context.secrets.get is await-compatible. Requires confirmWrites=true, $retries=0 and request.confirmation exactly firewalls-update. Acceptance does not establish completion; poll an Action Status node, and never automatically replay uncertain writes. Provider-added fields are omitted from the typed result. Response/request limits 1 MiB/128 KiB, deadline 100..30000ms, independently bounded cleanup 250ms. Sensitive generated passwords are deliberately excluded. Sources: https://docs.hetzner.cloud/reference/cloud https://docs.hetzner.cloud/changelog https://docs.hetzner.com/cloud/api/getting-started/using-api/ https://github.com/hetznercloud/hcloud-go/tree/main/hcloud/schema

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.documentation:
List SSH Keys. GET /ssh_keys. One bounded HTTPS request to api.hetzner.cloud only. Encrypted tokenSecret must be explicit; context.secrets.get is await-compatible. Read only. Lists fetch one requested page (maximum 50) and return nextPage for manual continuation. Provider-added fields are omitted from the typed result. Response/request limits 1 MiB/128 KiB, deadline 100..30000ms, independently bounded cleanup 250ms. Sensitive generated passwords are deliberately excluded. Sources: https://docs.hetzner.cloud/reference/cloud https://docs.hetzner.cloud/changelog https://docs.hetzner.com/cloud/api/getting-started/using-api/ https://github.com/hetznercloud/hcloud-go/tree/main/hcloud/schema

Lists fetch one requested page (maximum 50) and return nextPage for manual continuation. Provider-added fields are omitted from the typed result. Response/request limits 1 MiB/128 KiB, deadline 100..30000ms, independently bounded cleanup 250ms. Sensitive generated passwords are deliberately excluded. Sources: https://docs.hetzner.cloud/reference/cloud https://docs.hetzner.cloud/changelog https://docs.hetzner.com/cloud/api/getting-started/using-api/ https://github.com/hetznercloud/hcloud-go/tree/main/hcloud/schema

definitions.documentation:
Delete SSH Key. DELETE /ssh_keys/{id}. One bounded HTTPS request to api.hetzner.cloud only. Encrypted tokenSecret must be explicit; context.secrets.get is await-compatible. Requires confirmWrites=true, $retries=0 and request.confirmation exactly ssh_keys-delete. Acceptance does not establish completion; poll an Action Status node, and never automatically replay uncertain writes. Provider-added fields are omitted from the typed result. Response/request limits 1 MiB/128 KiB, deadline 100..30000ms, independently bounded cleanup 250ms. Sensitive generated passwords are deliberately excluded. Sources: https://docs.hetzner.cloud/reference/cloud https://docs.hetzner.cloud/changelog https://docs.hetzner.com/cloud/api/getting-started/using-api/ https://github.com/hetznercloud/hcloud-go/tree/main/hcloud/schema

Update SSH Key. PUT /ssh_keys/{id}. One bounded HTTPS request to api.hetzner.cloud only. Encrypted tokenSecret must be explicit; context.secrets.get is await-compatible. Requires confirmWrites=true, $retries=0 and request.confirmation exactly ssh_keys-update. Acceptance does not establish completion; poll an Action Status node, and never automatically replay uncertain writes. Provider-added fields are omitted from the typed result. Response/request limits 1 MiB/128 KiB, deadline 100..30000ms, independently bounded cleanup 250ms. Sensitive generated passwords are deliberately excluded. Sources: https://docs.hetzner.cloud/reference/cloud https://docs.hetzner.cloud/changelog https://docs.hetzner.com/cloud/api/getting-started/using-api/ https://github.com/hetznercloud/hcloud-go/tree/main/hcloud/schema

List Placement Groups. GET /placement_groups. One bounded HTTPS request to api.hetzner.cloud only. Encrypted tokenSecret must be explicit; context.secrets.get is await-compatible. Read only. Lists fetch one requested page (maximum 50) and return nextPage for manual continuation. Provider-added fields are omitted from the typed result. Response/request limits 1 MiB/128 KiB, deadline 100..30000ms, independently bounded cleanup 250ms. Sensitive generated passwords are deliberately excluded. definitions.name: List Load Balancers (Direct)
definitions.description: List Load Balancers
definitions.documentation:
List Load Balancers. GET /load_balancers. One bounded HTTPS request to api.hetzner.cloud only. Encrypted tokenSecret must be explicit; context.secrets.get is await-compatible. Read only. Lists fetch one requested page (maximum 50) and return nextPage for manual continuation. Provider-added fields are omitted from the typed result. Response/request limits 1 MiB/128 KiB, deadline 100..30000ms, independently bounded cleanup 250ms. Sensitive generated passwords are deliberately excluded. Sources: https://docs.hetzner.cloud/reference/cloud https://docs.hetzner.cloud/changelog https://docs.hetzner.com/cloud/api/getting-started/using-api/ https://github.com/hetznercloud/hcloud-go/tree/main/hcloud/schema

Get Load Balancer. GET /load_balancers/{id}. One bounded HTTPS request to api.hetzner.cloud only. Encrypted tokenSecret must be explicit; context.secrets.get is await-compatible. Read only. Lists fetch one requested page (maximum 50) and return nextPage for manual continuation. Provider-added fields are omitted from the typed result. Response/request limits 1 MiB/128 KiB, deadline 100..30000ms, independently bounded cleanup 250ms. Sensitive generated passwords are deliberately excluded. Delete Load Balancer. DELETE /load_balancers/{id}. One bounded HTTPS request to api.hetzner.cloud only. Encrypted tokenSecret must be explicit; context.secrets.get is await-compatible. Requires confirmWrites=true, $retries=0 and request.confirmation exactly load_balancers-delete. Acceptance does not establish completion; poll an Action Status node, and never automatically replay uncertain writes. Provider-added fields are omitted from the typed result. Response/request limits 1 MiB/128 KiB, deadline 100..30000ms, independently bounded cleanup 250ms. Sensitive generated passwords are deliberately excluded. definitions.description: Update Load Balancer
definitions.documentation:
Update Load Balancer. PUT /load_balancers/{id}. One bounded HTTPS request to api.hetzner.cloud only. Encrypted tokenSecret must be explicit; context.secrets.get is await-compatible. Requires confirmWrites=true, $retries=0 and request.confirmation exactly load_balancers-update. Acceptance does not establish completion; poll an Action Status node, and never automatically replay uncertain writes. Provider-added fields are omitted from the typed result. Response/request limits 1 MiB/128 KiB, deadline 100..30000ms, independently bounded cleanup 250ms. Sensitive generated passwords are deliberately excluded. Sources: https://docs.hetzner.cloud/reference/cloud https://docs.hetzner.cloud/changelog https://docs.hetzner.com/cloud/api/getting-started/using-api/ https://github.com/hetznercloud/hcloud-go/tree/main/hcloud/schema

definitions.documentation:
List Load Balancer Types. GET /load_balancer_types. One bounded HTTPS request to api.hetzner.cloud only. Encrypted tokenSecret must be explicit; context.secrets.get is await-compatible. Read only. Lists fetch one requested page (maximum 50) and return nextPage for manual continuation. Provider-added fields are omitted from the typed result. Response/request limits 1 MiB/128 KiB, deadline 100..30000ms, independently bounded cleanup 250ms. Sensitive generated passwords are deliberately excluded. Sources: https://docs.hetzner.cloud/reference/cloud https://docs.hetzner.cloud/changelog https://docs.hetzner.com/cloud/api/getting-started/using-api/ https://github.com/hetznercloud/hcloud-go/tree/main/hcloud/schema

definitions.name: Get Primary IP (Direct)
definitions.description: Get Primary IP
definitions.documentation:
Get Primary IP. GET /primary_ips/{id}. One bounded HTTPS request to api.hetzner.cloud only. Encrypted tokenSecret must be explicit; context.secrets.get is await-compatible. Read only. Lists fetch one requested page (maximum 50) and return nextPage for manual continuation. Provider-added fields are omitted from the typed result. Response/request limits 1 MiB/128 KiB, deadline 100..30000ms, independently bounded cleanup 250ms. Sensitive generated passwords are deliberately excluded. Sources: https://docs.hetzner.cloud/reference/cloud https://docs.hetzner.cloud/changelog https://docs.hetzner.com/cloud/api/getting-started/using-api/ https://github.com/hetznercloud/hcloud-go/tree/main/hcloud/schema

definitions.name: List Floating IPs (Direct)
definitions.description: List Floating IPs
definitions.documentation:
List Floating IPs. GET /floating_ips. One bounded HTTPS request to api.hetzner.cloud only. Encrypted tokenSecret must be explicit; context.secrets.get is await-compatible. Read only. Lists fetch one requested page (maximum 50) and return nextPage for manual continuation. Provider-added fields are omitted from the typed result. Response/request limits 1 MiB/128 KiB, deadline 100..30000ms, independently bounded cleanup 250ms. Sensitive generated passwords are deliberately excluded. Sources: https://docs.hetzner.cloud/reference/cloud https://docs.hetzner.cloud/changelog https://docs.hetzner.com/cloud/api/getting-started/using-api/ https://github.com/hetznercloud/hcloud-go/tree/main/hcloud/schema

definitions.name: Get Floating IP (Direct)
definitions.description: Get Floating IP
definitions.documentation:
Get Floating IP. GET /floating_ips/{id}. One bounded HTTPS request to api.hetzner.cloud only. Encrypted tokenSecret must be explicit; context.secrets.get is await-compatible. Read only. Lists fetch one requested page (maximum 50) and return nextPage for manual continuation. Provider-added fields are omitted from the typed result. Response/request limits 1 MiB/128 KiB, deadline 100..30000ms, independently bounded cleanup 250ms. Sensitive generated passwords are deliberately excluded. Sources: https://docs.hetzner.cloud/reference/cloud https://docs.hetzner.cloud/changelog https://docs.hetzner.com/cloud/api/getting-started/using-api/ https://github.com/hetznercloud/hcloud-go/tree/main/hcloud/schema

definitions.description: Get Multiple Actions
definitions.documentation:
Get Multiple Actions. GET /actions. One bounded HTTPS request to api.hetzner.cloud only. Encrypted tokenSecret must be explicit; context.secrets.get is await-compatible. Read only. Lists fetch one requested page (maximum 50) and return nextPage for manual continuation. Provider-added fields are omitted from the typed result. Response/request limits 1 MiB/128 KiB, deadline 100..30000ms, independently bounded cleanup 250ms. Sensitive generated passwords are deliberately excluded. Sources: https://docs.hetzner.cloud/reference/cloud https://docs.hetzner.cloud/changelog https://docs.hetzner.com/cloud/api/getting-started/using-api/ https://github.com/hetznercloud/hcloud-go/tree/main/hcloud/schema

definitions.description: Get servers Action Status
definitions.documentation:
Get servers Action Status. GET /servers/actions/{id}. One bounded HTTPS request to api.hetzner.cloud only. Encrypted tokenSecret must be explicit; context.secrets.get is await-compatible. Read only. Lists fetch one requested page (maximum 50) and return nextPage for manual continuation. Provider-added fields are omitted from the typed result. Response/request limits 1 MiB/128 KiB, deadline 100..30000ms, independently bounded cleanup 250ms. Sensitive generated passwords are deliberately excluded. Sources: https://docs.hetzner.cloud/reference/cloud https://docs.hetzner.cloud/changelog https://docs.hetzner.com/cloud/api/getting-started/using-api/ https://github.com/hetznercloud/hcloud-go/tree/main/hcloud/schema

definitions.description: List volumes Actions
definitions.documentation:
List volumes Actions. GET /volumes/{id}/actions. One bounded HTTPS request to api.hetzner.cloud only. Encrypted tokenSecret must be explicit; context.secrets.get is await-compatible. Read only. Lists fetch one requested page (maximum 50) and return nextPage for manual continuation. Provider-added fields are omitted from the typed result. Response/request limits 1 MiB/128 KiB, deadline 100..30000ms, independently bounded cleanup 250ms. Sensitive generated passwords are deliberately excluded. Sources: https://docs.hetzner.cloud/reference/cloud https://docs.hetzner.cloud/changelog https://docs.hetzner.com/cloud/api/getting-started/using-api/ https://github.com/hetznercloud/hcloud-go/tree/main/hcloud/schema

definitions.name: Get networks Action Status (Direct)
definitions.description: Get networks Action Status
definitions.documentation:
Get networks Action Status. GET /networks/actions/{id}. One bounded HTTPS request to api.hetzner.cloud only. Encrypted tokenSecret must be explicit; context.secrets.get is await-compatible. Read only. Lists fetch one requested page (maximum 50) and return nextPage for manual continuation. Provider-added fields are omitted from the typed result. Response/request limits 1 MiB/128 KiB, deadline 100..30000ms, independently bounded cleanup 250ms. Sensitive generated passwords are deliberately excluded. Sources: https://docs.hetzner.cloud/reference/cloud https://docs.hetzner.cloud/changelog https://docs.hetzner.com/cloud/api/getting-started/using-api/ https://github.com/hetznercloud/hcloud-go/tree/main/hcloud/schema

definitions.description: List load balancers Actions
definitions.documentation:
List load balancers Actions. GET /load_balancers/{id}/actions. One bounded HTTPS request to api.hetzner.cloud only. Encrypted tokenSecret must be explicit; context.secrets.get is await-compatible. Read only. Lists fetch one requested page (maximum 50) and return nextPage for manual continuation. Provider-added fields are omitted from the typed result. Response/request limits 1 MiB/128 KiB, deadline 100..30000ms, independently bounded cleanup 250ms. Sensitive generated passwords are deliberately excluded. Sources: https://docs.hetzner.cloud/reference/cloud https://docs.hetzner.cloud/changelog https://docs.hetzner.com/cloud/api/getting-started/using-api/ https://github.com/hetznercloud/hcloud-go/tree/main/hcloud/schema

definitions.description: Get primary ips Action Status
definitions.documentation:
Get primary ips Action Status. GET /primary_ips/actions/{id}. One bounded HTTPS request to api.hetzner.cloud only. Encrypted tokenSecret must be explicit; context.secrets.get is await-compatible. Read only. Lists fetch one requested page (maximum 50) and return nextPage for manual continuation. Provider-added fields are omitted from the typed result. Response/request limits 1 MiB/128 KiB, deadline 100..30000ms, independently bounded cleanup 250ms. Sensitive generated passwords are deliberately excluded. Sources: https://docs.hetzner.cloud/reference/cloud https://docs.hetzner.cloud/changelog https://docs.hetzner.com/cloud/api/getting-started/using-api/ https://github.com/hetznercloud/hcloud-go/tree/main/hcloud/schema

Read only. Lists fetch one requested page (maximum 50) and return nextPage for manual continuation. Provider-added fields are omitted from the typed result. Read only. Lists fetch one requested page (maximum 50) and return nextPage for manual continuation. Provider-added fields are omitted from the typed result. Response/request limits 1 MiB/128 KiB, deadline 100..30000ms, independently bounded cleanup 250ms. Sensitive generated passwords are deliberately excluded. Create Server. POST /servers. One bounded HTTPS request to api.hetzner.cloud only. Encrypted tokenSecret must be explicit; context.secrets.get is await-compatible. Requires confirmWrites=true, $retries=0 and request.confirmation exactly servers-create. Acceptance does not establish completion; poll an Action Status node, and never automatically replay uncertain writes. Provider-added fields are omitted from the typed result. definitions.name: servers disable rescue (Direct)
definitions.description: servers disable rescue
definitions.documentation:
servers disable rescue. POST /servers/{id}/actions/disable_rescue. One bounded HTTPS request to api.hetzner.cloud only. Encrypted tokenSecret must be explicit; context.secrets.get is await-compatible. Requires confirmWrites=true, $retries=0 and request.confirmation exactly servers-disable_rescue. Acceptance does not establish completion; poll an Action Status node, and never automatically replay uncertain writes. Provider-added fields are omitted from the typed result. Response/request limits 1 MiB/128 KiB, deadline 100..30000ms, independently bounded cleanup 250ms. Sensitive generated passwords are deliberately excluded. Sources: https://docs.hetzner.cloud/reference/cloud https://docs.hetzner.cloud/changelog https://docs.hetzner.com/cloud/api/getting-started/using-api/ https://github.com/hetznercloud/hcloud-go/tree/main/hcloud/schema

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.documentation:
servers rebuild. POST /servers/{id}/actions/rebuild. One bounded HTTPS request to api.hetzner.cloud only. Encrypted tokenSecret must be explicit; context.secrets.get is await-compatible. Requires confirmWrites=true, $retries=0 and request.confirmation exactly servers-rebuild. Acceptance does not establish completion; poll an Action Status node, and never automatically replay uncertain writes. Provider-added fields are omitted from the typed result. Response/request limits 1 MiB/128 KiB, deadline 100..30000ms, independently bounded cleanup 250ms. Sensitive generated passwords are deliberately excluded. Sources: https://docs.hetzner.cloud/reference/cloud https://docs.hetzner.cloud/changelog https://docs.hetzner.com/cloud/api/getting-started/using-api/ https://github.com/hetznercloud/hcloud-go/tree/main/hcloud/schema

definitions.documentation:
servers attach iso. POST /servers/{id}/actions/attach_iso. One bounded HTTPS request to api.hetzner.cloud only. Encrypted tokenSecret must be explicit; context.secrets.get is await-compatible. Requires confirmWrites=true, $retries=0 and request.confirmation exactly servers-attach_iso. Acceptance does not establish completion; poll an Action Status node, and never automatically replay uncertain writes. Provider-added fields are omitted from the typed result. Response/request limits 1 MiB/128 KiB, deadline 100..30000ms, independently bounded cleanup 250ms. Sensitive generated passwords are deliberately excluded. Sources: https://docs.hetzner.cloud/reference/cloud https://docs.hetzner.cloud/changelog https://docs.hetzner.com/cloud/api/getting-started/using-api/ https://github.com/hetznercloud/hcloud-go/tree/main/hcloud/schema

definitions.documentation:
servers attach to network. POST /servers/{id}/actions/attach_to_network. One bounded HTTPS request to api.hetzner.cloud only. Encrypted tokenSecret must be explicit; context.secrets.get is await-compatible. Requires confirmWrites=true, $retries=0 and request.confirmation exactly servers-attach_to_network. Acceptance does not establish completion; poll an Action Status node, and never automatically replay uncertain writes. Provider-added fields are omitted from the typed result. Response/request limits 1 MiB/128 KiB, deadline 100..30000ms, independently bounded cleanup 250ms. Sensitive generated passwords are deliberately excluded. Sources: https://docs.hetzner.cloud/reference/cloud https://docs.hetzner.cloud/changelog https://docs.hetzner.com/cloud/api/getting-started/using-api/ https://github.com/hetznercloud/hcloud-go/tree/main/hcloud/schema

definitions.documentation:
servers detach from network. POST /servers/{id}/actions/detach_from_network. One bounded HTTPS request to api.hetzner.cloud only. Encrypted tokenSecret must be explicit; context.secrets.get is await-compatible. Requires confirmWrites=true, $retries=0 and request.confirmation exactly servers-detach_from_network. Acceptance does not establish completion; poll an Action Status node, and never automatically replay uncertain writes. Provider-added fields are omitted from the typed result. Response/request limits 1 MiB/128 KiB, deadline 100..30000ms, independently bounded cleanup 250ms. Sensitive generated passwords are deliberately excluded. Sources: https://docs.hetzner.cloud/reference/cloud https://docs.hetzner.cloud/changelog https://docs.hetzner.com/cloud/api/getting-started/using-api/ https://github.com/hetznercloud/hcloud-go/tree/main/hcloud/schema

definitions.documentation:
servers change alias ips. POST /servers/{id}/actions/change_alias_ips. One bounded HTTPS request to api.hetzner.cloud only. Encrypted tokenSecret must be explicit; context.secrets.get is await-compatible. Requires confirmWrites=true, $retries=0 and request.confirmation exactly servers-change_alias_ips. Acceptance does not establish completion; poll an Action Status node, and never automatically replay uncertain writes. Provider-added fields are omitted from the typed result. Response/request limits 1 MiB/128 KiB, deadline 100..30000ms, independently bounded cleanup 250ms. Sensitive generated passwords are deliberately excluded. Sources: https://docs.hetzner.cloud/reference/cloud https://docs.hetzner.cloud/changelog https://docs.hetzner.com/cloud/api/getting-started/using-api/ https://github.com/hetznercloud/hcloud-go/tree/main/hcloud/schema

definitions.description: Create Volume
definitions.documentation:
Create Volume. POST /volumes. One bounded HTTPS request to api.hetzner.cloud only. Encrypted tokenSecret must be explicit; context.secrets.get is await-compatible. Requires confirmWrites=true, $retries=0 and request.confirmation exactly volumes-create. Acceptance does not establish completion; poll an Action Status node, and never automatically replay uncertain writes. Provider-added fields are omitted from the typed result. Response/request limits 1 MiB/128 KiB, deadline 100..30000ms, independently bounded cleanup 250ms. Sensitive generated passwords are deliberately excluded. Sources: https://docs.hetzner.cloud/reference/cloud https://docs.hetzner.cloud/changelog https://docs.hetzner.com/cloud/api/getting-started/using-api/ https://github.com/hetznercloud/hcloud-go/tree/main/hcloud/schema

definitions.documentation:
volumes attach. POST /volumes/{id}/actions/attach. One bounded HTTPS request to api.hetzner.cloud only. Encrypted tokenSecret must be explicit; context.secrets.get is await-compatible. Requires confirmWrites=true, $retries=0 and request.confirmation exactly volumes-attach. Acceptance does not establish completion; poll an Action Status node, and never automatically replay uncertain writes. Provider-added fields are omitted from the typed result. Response/request limits 1 MiB/128 KiB, deadline 100..30000ms, independently bounded cleanup 250ms. Sensitive generated passwords are deliberately excluded. Sources: https://docs.hetzner.cloud/reference/cloud https://docs.hetzner.cloud/changelog https://docs.hetzner.com/cloud/api/getting-started/using-api/ https://github.com/hetznercloud/hcloud-go/tree/main/hcloud/schema

definitions.documentation:
volumes detach. POST /volumes/{id}/actions/detach. One bounded HTTPS request to api.hetzner.cloud only. Encrypted tokenSecret must be explicit; context.secrets.get is await-compatible. Requires confirmWrites=true, $retries=0 and request.confirmation exactly volumes-detach. Acceptance does not establish completion; poll an Action Status node, and never automatically replay uncertain writes. Provider-added fields are omitted from the typed result. Response/request limits 1 MiB/128 KiB, deadline 100..30000ms, independently bounded cleanup 250ms. Sensitive generated passwords are deliberately excluded. Sources: https://docs.hetzner.cloud/reference/cloud https://docs.hetzner.cloud/changelog https://docs.hetzner.com/cloud/api/getting-started/using-api/ https://github.com/hetznercloud/hcloud-go/tree/main/hcloud/schema

networks add subnet. POST /networks/{id}/actions/add_subnet. One bounded HTTPS request to api.hetzner.cloud only. Encrypted tokenSecret must be explicit; context.secrets.get is await-compatible. Requires confirmWrites=true, $retries=0 and request.confirmation exactly networks-add_subnet. Acceptance does not establish completion; poll an Action Status node, and never automatically replay uncertain writes. Provider-added fields are omitted from the typed result. Response/request limits 1 MiB/128 KiB, deadline 100..30000ms, independently bounded cleanup 250ms. Sensitive generated passwords are deliberately excluded. Sources: https://docs.hetzner.cloud/reference/cloud https://docs.hetzner.cloud/changelog https://docs.hetzner.com/cloud/api/getting-started/using-api/ https://github.com/hetznercloud/hcloud-go/tree/main/hcloud/schema

definitions.documentation:
networks delete route. POST /networks/{id}/actions/delete_route. One bounded HTTPS request to api.hetzner.cloud only. Encrypted tokenSecret must be explicit; context.secrets.get is await-compatible. Requires confirmWrites=true, $retries=0 and request.confirmation exactly networks-delete_route. Acceptance does not establish completion; poll an Action Status node, and never automatically replay uncertain writes. Provider-added fields are omitted from the typed result. Response/request limits 1 MiB/128 KiB, deadline 100..30000ms, independently bounded cleanup 250ms. Sensitive generated passwords are deliberately excluded. Sources: https://docs.hetzner.cloud/reference/cloud https://docs.hetzner.cloud/changelog https://docs.hetzner.com/cloud/api/getting-started/using-api/ https://github.com/hetznercloud/hcloud-go/tree/main/hcloud/schema

definitions.name: Create Firewall (Direct)
definitions.description: Create Firewall
definitions.documentation:
Create Firewall. POST /firewalls. One bounded HTTPS request to api.hetzner.cloud only. Encrypted tokenSecret must be explicit; context.secrets.get is await-compatible. Requires confirmWrites=true, $retries=0 and request.confirmation exactly firewalls-create. Acceptance does not establish completion; poll an Action Status node, and never automatically replay uncertain writes. Provider-added fields are omitted from the typed result. Response/request limits 1 MiB/128 KiB, deadline 100..30000ms, independently bounded cleanup 250ms. Sensitive generated passwords are deliberately excluded. Sources: https://docs.hetzner.cloud/reference/cloud https://docs.hetzner.cloud/changelog https://docs.hetzner.com/cloud/api/getting-started/using-api/ https://github.com/hetznercloud/hcloud-go/tree/main/hcloud/schema

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.documentation:
firewalls set rules. POST /firewalls/{id}/actions/set_rules. One bounded HTTPS request to api.hetzner.cloud only. Encrypted tokenSecret must be explicit; context.secrets.get is await-compatible. Requires confirmWrites=true, $retries=0 and request.confirmation exactly firewalls-set_rules. Acceptance does not establish completion; poll an Action Status node, and never automatically replay uncertain writes. Provider-added fields are omitted from the typed result. Response/request limits 1 MiB/128 KiB, deadline 100..30000ms, independently bounded cleanup 250ms. Sensitive generated passwords are deliberately excluded. Sources: https://docs.hetzner.cloud/reference/cloud https://docs.hetzner.cloud/changelog https://docs.hetzner.com/cloud/api/getting-started/using-api/ https://github.com/hetznercloud/hcloud-go/tree/main/hcloud/schema

definitions.documentation:
firewalls apply to resources. POST /firewalls/{id}/actions/apply_to_resources. One bounded HTTPS request to api.hetzner.cloud only. Encrypted tokenSecret must be explicit; context.secrets.get is await-compatible. Requires confirmWrites=true, $retries=0 and request.confirmation exactly firewalls-apply_to_resources. Acceptance does not establish completion; poll an Action Status node, and never automatically replay uncertain writes. Provider-added fields are omitted from the typed result. Response/request limits 1 MiB/128 KiB, deadline 100..30000ms, independently bounded cleanup 250ms. Sensitive generated passwords are deliberately excluded. Sources: https://docs.hetzner.cloud/reference/cloud https://docs.hetzner.cloud/changelog https://docs.hetzner.com/cloud/api/getting-started/using-api/ https://github.com/hetznercloud/hcloud-go/tree/main/hcloud/schema

definitions.documentation:
firewalls remove from resources. POST /firewalls/{id}/actions/remove_from_resources. One bounded HTTPS request to api.hetzner.cloud only. Encrypted tokenSecret must be explicit; context.secrets.get is await-compatible. Requires confirmWrites=true, $retries=0 and request.confirmation exactly firewalls-remove_from_resources. Acceptance does not establish completion; poll an Action Status node, and never automatically replay uncertain writes. Provider-added fields are omitted from the typed result. Response/request limits 1 MiB/128 KiB, deadline 100..30000ms, independently bounded cleanup 250ms. Sensitive generated passwords are deliberately excluded. Sources: https://docs.hetzner.cloud/reference/cloud https://docs.hetzner.cloud/changelog https://docs.hetzner.com/cloud/api/getting-started/using-api/ https://github.com/hetznercloud/hcloud-go/tree/main/hcloud/schema

definitions.documentation:
Create Load Balancer. POST /load_balancers. One bounded HTTPS request to api.hetzner.cloud only. Encrypted tokenSecret must be explicit; context.secrets.get is await-compatible. Requires confirmWrites=true, $retries=0 and request.confirmation exactly load_balancers-create. Acceptance does not establish completion; poll an Action Status node, and never automatically replay uncertain writes. Provider-added fields are omitted from the typed result. Response/request limits 1 MiB/128 KiB, deadline 100..30000ms, independently bounded cleanup 250ms. Sensitive generated passwords are deliberately excluded. Sources: https://docs.hetzner.cloud/reference/cloud https://docs.hetzner.cloud/changelog https://docs.hetzner.com/cloud/api/getting-started/using-api/ https://github.com/hetznercloud/hcloud-go/tree/main/hcloud/schema

definitions.documentation:
Load balancer add target. POST /load_balancers/{id}/actions/add_target. One bounded HTTPS request to api.hetzner.cloud only. Encrypted tokenSecret must be explicit; context.secrets.get is await-compatible. Requires confirmWrites=true, $retries=0 and request.confirmation exactly load_balancers-add_target. Acceptance does not establish completion; poll an Action Status node, and never automatically replay uncertain writes. Provider-added fields are omitted from the typed result. Response/request limits 1 MiB/128 KiB, deadline 100..30000ms, independently bounded cleanup 250ms. Sensitive generated passwords are deliberately excluded. Sources: https://docs.hetzner.cloud/reference/cloud https://docs.hetzner.cloud/changelog https://docs.hetzner.com/cloud/api/getting-started/using-api/ https://github.com/hetznercloud/hcloud-go/tree/main/hcloud/schema

Load balancer remove target. POST /load_balancers/{id}/actions/remove_target. One bounded HTTPS request to api.hetzner.cloud only. Encrypted tokenSecret must be explicit; context.secrets.get is await-compatible. Requires confirmWrites=true, $retries=0 and request.confirmation exactly load_balancers-remove_target. Acceptance does not establish completion; poll an Action Status node, and never automatically replay uncertain writes. Provider-added fields are omitted from the typed result. Response/request limits 1 MiB/128 KiB, deadline 100..30000ms, independently bounded cleanup 250ms. Sensitive generated passwords are deliberately excluded. Sources: https://docs.hetzner.cloud/reference/cloud https://docs.hetzner.cloud/changelog https://docs.hetzner.com/cloud/api/getting-started/using-api/ https://github.com/hetznercloud/hcloud-go/tree/main/hcloud/schema

load balancers add service. POST /load_balancers/{id}/actions/add_service. One bounded HTTPS request to api.hetzner.cloud only. Encrypted tokenSecret must be explicit; context.secrets.get is await-compatible. Requires confirmWrites=true, $retries=0 and request.confirmation exactly load_balancers-add_service. Acceptance does not establish completion; poll an Action Status node, and never automatically replay uncertain writes. Provider-added fields are omitted from the typed result. Response/request limits 1 MiB/128 KiB, deadline 100..30000ms, independently bounded cleanup 250ms. Sensitive generated passwords are deliberately excluded. Sources: https://docs.hetzner.cloud/reference/cloud https://docs.hetzner.cloud/changelog https://docs.hetzner.com/cloud/api/getting-started/using-api/ https://github.com/hetznercloud/hcloud-go/tree/main/hcloud/schema

definitions.documentation:
load balancers update service. POST /load_balancers/{id}/actions/update_service. One bounded HTTPS request to api.hetzner.cloud only. Encrypted tokenSecret must be explicit; context.secrets.get is await-compatible. Requires confirmWrites=true, $retries=0 and request.confirmation exactly load_balancers-update_service. Acceptance does not establish completion; poll an Action Status node, and never automatically replay uncertain writes. Provider-added fields are omitted from the typed result. Response/request limits 1 MiB/128 KiB, deadline 100..30000ms, independently bounded cleanup 250ms. Sensitive generated passwords are deliberately excluded. Sources: https://docs.hetzner.cloud/reference/cloud https://docs.hetzner.cloud/changelog https://docs.hetzner.com/cloud/api/getting-started/using-api/ https://github.com/hetznercloud/hcloud-go/tree/main/hcloud/schema

load balancers change type. POST /load_balancers/{id}/actions/change_type. One bounded HTTPS request to api.hetzner.cloud only. Encrypted tokenSecret must be explicit; context.secrets.get is await-compatible. Requires confirmWrites=true, $retries=0 and request.confirmation exactly load_balancers-change_type. Acceptance does not establish completion; poll an Action Status node, and never automatically replay uncertain writes. Provider-added fields are omitted from the typed result. Response/request limits 1 MiB/128 KiB, deadline 100..30000ms, independently bounded cleanup 250ms. Sensitive generated passwords are deliberately excluded. Sources: https://docs.hetzner.cloud/reference/cloud https://docs.hetzner.cloud/changelog https://docs.hetzner.com/cloud/api/getting-started/using-api/ https://github.com/hetznercloud/hcloud-go/tree/main/hcloud/schema

definitions.documentation:
load balancers attach to network. POST /load_balancers/{id}/actions/attach_to_network. One bounded HTTPS request to api.hetzner.cloud only. Encrypted tokenSecret must be explicit; context.secrets.get is await-compatible. Requires confirmWrites=true, $retries=0 and request.confirmation exactly load_balancers-attach_to_network. Acceptance does not establish completion; poll an Action Status node, and never automatically replay uncertain writes. Provider-added fields are omitted from the typed result. Response/request limits 1 MiB/128 KiB, deadline 100..30000ms, independently bounded cleanup 250ms. Sensitive generated passwords are deliberately excluded. Sources: https://docs.hetzner.cloud/reference/cloud https://docs.hetzner.cloud/changelog https://docs.hetzner.com/cloud/api/getting-started/using-api/ https://github.com/hetznercloud/hcloud-go/tree/main/hcloud/schema

definitions.description: primary ips assign
definitions.documentation:
primary ips assign. POST /primary_ips/{id}/actions/assign. One bounded HTTPS request to api.hetzner.cloud only. Encrypted tokenSecret must be explicit; context.secrets.get is await-compatible. Requires confirmWrites=true, $retries=0 and request.confirmation exactly primary_ips-assign. Acceptance does not establish completion; poll an Action Status node, and never automatically replay uncertain writes. Provider-added fields are omitted from the typed result. Response/request limits 1 MiB/128 KiB, deadline 100..30000ms, independently bounded cleanup 250ms. Sensitive generated passwords are deliberately excluded. Sources: https://docs.hetzner.cloud/reference/cloud https://docs.hetzner.cloud/changelog https://docs.hetzner.com/cloud/api/getting-started/using-api/ https://github.com/hetznercloud/hcloud-go/tree/main/hcloud/schema

definitions.description: primary ips unassign
definitions.documentation:
primary ips unassign. POST /primary_ips/{id}/actions/unassign. One bounded HTTPS request to api.hetzner.cloud only. Encrypted tokenSecret must be explicit; context.secrets.get is await-compatible. Requires confirmWrites=true, $retries=0 and request.confirmation exactly primary_ips-unassign. Acceptance does not establish completion; poll an Action Status node, and never automatically replay uncertain writes. Provider-added fields are omitted from the typed result. Response/request limits 1 MiB/128 KiB, deadline 100..30000ms, independently bounded cleanup 250ms. Sensitive generated passwords are deliberately excluded. Sources: https://docs.hetzner.cloud/reference/cloud https://docs.hetzner.cloud/changelog https://docs.hetzner.com/cloud/api/getting-started/using-api/ https://github.com/hetznercloud/hcloud-go/tree/main/hcloud/schema

Create Floating IP. POST /floating_ips. One bounded HTTPS request to api.hetzner.cloud only. Encrypted tokenSecret must be explicit; context.secrets.get is await-compatible. Requires confirmWrites=true, $retries=0 and request.confirmation exactly floating_ips-create. Acceptance does not establish completion; poll an Action Status node, and never automatically replay uncertain writes. Provider-added fields are omitted from the typed result. Response/request limits 1 MiB/128 KiB, deadline 100..30000ms, independently bounded cleanup 250ms. Sensitive generated passwords are deliberately excluded. Sources: https://docs.hetzner.cloud/reference/cloud https://docs.hetzner.cloud/changelog https://docs.hetzner.com/cloud/api/getting-started/using-api/ https://github.com/hetznercloud/hcloud-go/tree/main/hcloud/schema

definitions.documentation:
servers change dns ptr. POST /servers/{id}/actions/change_dns_ptr. One bounded HTTPS request to api.hetzner.cloud only. Encrypted tokenSecret must be explicit; context.secrets.get is await-compatible. Requires confirmWrites=true, $retries=0 and request.confirmation exactly servers-change_dns_ptr. Acceptance does not establish completion; poll an Action Status node, and never automatically replay uncertain writes. Provider-added fields are omitted from the typed result. Response/request limits 1 MiB/128 KiB, deadline 100..30000ms, independently bounded cleanup 250ms. Sensitive generated passwords are deliberately excluded. Sources: https://docs.hetzner.cloud/reference/cloud https://docs.hetzner.cloud/changelog https://docs.hetzner.com/cloud/api/getting-started/using-api/ https://github.com/hetznercloud/hcloud-go/tree/main/hcloud/schema

primary ips change dns ptr. POST /primary_ips/{id}/actions/change_dns_ptr. One bounded HTTPS request to api.hetzner.cloud only. Encrypted tokenSecret must be explicit; context.secrets.get is await-compatible. Requires confirmWrites=true, $retries=0 and request.confirmation exactly primary_ips-change_dns_ptr. Acceptance does not establish completion; poll an Action Status node, and never automatically replay uncertain writes. Provider-added fields are omitted from the typed result. Response/request limits 1 MiB/128 KiB, deadline 100..30000ms, independently bounded cleanup 250ms. Sensitive generated passwords are deliberately excluded. Sources: https://docs.hetzner.cloud/reference/cloud https://docs.hetzner.cloud/changelog https://docs.hetzner.com/cloud/api/getting-started/using-api/ https://github.com/hetznercloud/hcloud-go/tree/main/hcloud/schema

images change protection. POST /images/{id}/actions/change_protection. One bounded HTTPS request to api.hetzner.cloud only. Encrypted tokenSecret must be explicit; context.secrets.get is await-compatible. Requires confirmWrites=true, $retries=0 and request.confirmation exactly images-change_protection. Acceptance does not establish completion; poll an Action Status node, and never automatically replay uncertain writes. Provider-added fields are omitted from the typed result. Response/request limits 1 MiB/128 KiB, deadline 100..30000ms, independently bounded cleanup 250ms. Sensitive generated passwords are deliberately excluded. Sources: https://docs.hetzner.cloud/reference/cloud https://docs.hetzner.cloud/changelog https://docs.hetzner.com/cloud/api/getting-started/using-api/ https://github.com/hetznercloud/hcloud-go/tree/main/hcloud/schema

definitions.description: volumes change protection
definitions.documentation:
volumes change protection. POST /volumes/{id}/actions/change_protection. One bounded HTTPS request to api.hetzner.cloud only. Encrypted tokenSecret must be explicit; context.secrets.get is await-compatible. Requires confirmWrites=true, $retries=0 and request.confirmation exactly volumes-change_protection. Acceptance does not establish completion; poll an Action Status node, and never automatically replay uncertain writes. Provider-added fields are omitted from the typed result. Response/request limits 1 MiB/128 KiB, deadline 100..30000ms, independently bounded cleanup 250ms. Sensitive generated passwords are deliberately excluded. Sources: https://docs.hetzner.cloud/reference/cloud https://docs.hetzner.cloud/changelog https://docs.hetzner.com/cloud/api/getting-started/using-api/ https://github.com/hetznercloud/hcloud-go/tree/main/hcloud/schema

definitions.description: floating ips change protection
definitions.documentation:
floating ips change protection. POST /floating_ips/{id}/actions/change_protection. One bounded HTTPS request to api.hetzner.cloud only. Encrypted tokenSecret must be explicit; context.secrets.get is await-compatible. Requires confirmWrites=true, $retries=0 and request.confirmation exactly floating_ips-change_protection. Acceptance does not establish completion; poll an Action Status node, and never automatically replay uncertain writes. Provider-added fields are omitted from the typed result. Response/request limits 1 MiB/128 KiB, deadline 100..30000ms, independently bounded cleanup 250ms. Sensitive generated passwords are deliberately excluded. Sources: https://docs.hetzner.cloud/reference/cloud https://docs.hetzner.cloud/changelog https://docs.hetzner.com/cloud/api/getting-started/using-api/ https://github.com/hetznercloud/hcloud-go/tree/main/hcloud/schema

definitions.description: load balancers change protection
definitions.documentation:
load balancers change protection. POST /load_balancers/{id}/actions/change_protection. One bounded HTTPS request to api.hetzner.cloud only. Encrypted tokenSecret must be explicit; context.secrets.get is await-compatible. Requires confirmWrites=true, $retries=0 and request.confirmation exactly load_balancers-change_protection. Acceptance does not establish completion; poll an Action Status node, and never automatically replay uncertain writes. Provider-added fields are omitted from the typed result. Response/request limits 1 MiB/128 KiB, deadline 100..30000ms, independently bounded cleanup 250ms. Sensitive generated passwords are deliberately excluded. Sources: https://docs.hetzner.cloud/reference/cloud https://docs.hetzner.cloud/changelog https://docs.hetzner.com/cloud/api/getting-started/using-api/ https://github.com/hetznercloud/hcloud-go/tree/main/hcloud/schema
